facts.Page story text 1 (draft, teacher check: Tom's friend Ben came by. Tom pretended painting was fun. Ben wanted to try too. He tricked his friends.
facts.Page story text 2 (draft, teacher check: Tom's friend Ben walked by eating a juicy red apple. Ben laughed at Tom for having to work on a Saturday morning. But Tom pretended that painting the fence was incredibly fun. He tricked his friends into wanting to paint the fence too. Ben begged Tom to let him try and even gave his apple. Tom's clever plan was working perfectly just as he hoped.
facts.Word cards: tricked = 속였다 / pretended = ~인 척했다 / convinced = 납득시켰다 / Ben = 벤
